actions.action: Free changes and cancellations for bookings in a 2-week window
Lease an aircraft with crew for 2 weeks
Extra airport and call-center staff for 2 weeks

message: Kestrel Air update on the FAA engine inspections: the checks are a precaution ordered for one engine type, and no Kestrel aircraft has had a problem with this part. We have leased a spare aircraft with crew to keep your flights running and added staff at the airports and on the phones. If you would rather change or cancel a trip between Nov 23 and Dec 6, you can do it at no cost in the app.
why:
The inspections take aircraft out of service in Thanksgiving week.
A leased spare protects the 98% flights goal and rebooking.
A calm, factual message answers the TikTok video and free changes cut anxiety.

actions.action: Backup ground handling contract at both bases for the strike days
Rebooking deal with a partner airline for 2 disrupted weeks

message: A ground handling strike is planned at Orlando and Philadelphia on December 22-23. We have arranged the following: backup ground handling is contracted for the December 22-23 strike; canceled travelers can take an available partner-airline seat at no extra charge. Please check flight status in the app. If your flight is canceled, you may also choose the refund required by law.
why:
The announced ground handling strike threatens flights at both bases.
The contracted capacity or passenger options reduce disruption and its impact.
The package fits the remaining $1M second-decision limit.
